Not at slice depth: run records carry the amendment flag (run_open amendment=, run_set(amendment=)) and only run_live is defined (decision D5). The survey must mark the amendment when the cycle's route is standard and the cycle has no approved spec decision of its own. Package S3 takes it.

Decision D4 in code: store_step refuses a second write to a step key (step_exists) unless the same agent_id writes again or the content is identical, so a review loop that runs twice in one story cannot mix its passes and an agent whose result the platform refused can replace it. Tested in test_step_collision. The repair-round step-name prefix is the story script's part (W2).

evidence_write refuses an incomplete re-freeze (refreeze_incomplete): a re-freeze must list every file the latest earlier red record froze, and a passing red record must carry frozen, tests and criteria. Tested in test_refreeze_incomplete.

Kept the store's own schema check (write_record validates every step record against step-record, which $refs step-result) and kept D4's same-agent_id replacement instead of a flat refusal, so an agent whose result the platform's check refused answers again with the same agent_id and replaces it. Tested in test_step_collision and the schema fixtures.

flush never raises: a git failure comes back as state failed with the cause in error, and a failure whose text is the sandbox's Operation not permitted names the Bash sandbox and points at the hook path. Tested in test_flush_never_raises; stated in spec topics/state-commits.md.

flush reads the changed paths through the state core's changed_paths helper (which passes -uall) and never open-codes git status; the requirement is stated once in spec topics/state-commits.md so future callers see it. Committed state lands through flush's helper in test_flush.

closure_update is the one write path for every writer, the survey included: the spec's Written by list now names vsdd survey (through the worktree library) and the single write path, and the store's test_closure exercises closure_update as the only writer. Tested in test_closures.
